eligibility.description: metadata-only filter on the catalogue elements; keeps the low-inclination, low-eccentricity main-belt core where low-thrust hops are physically plausible

selection.rank_key: SHA-256 of the UTF-8 string 'gtoc12-reduced-v1:<asteroid_id>' interpreted as a big-endian 256-bit unsigned integer
selection.rule: sort eligible asteroid IDs by rank_key ascending and keep the first 1000; ties are impossible in practice and would be broken by ascending ID

fleet.note: single-ship instance; the official fleet-size rule N <= min(100, 2 exp(rho M_bar)) is still evaluated and must hold

dynamics_and_rules: official GTOC12 dynamics, ship parameters, mining rules, tolerances and verifier semantics are unchanged; only the candidate asteroid set and ship count are restricted

scoring.primary: unweighted collected mass returned to Earth (official offline verifier output)
scoring.secondary: fixed post-competition bonus-weighted mass using bonus_coefficients.txt
